description: 1. Agent reads sessions/raw/june_new_visitors.txt and references/cold_start_playbook.md (ignoring distractor files like campaigns/past/loyalty_winback_q1.md and ops/discount_codes/active_codes.txt). 2. Agent follows the 4-step core workflow: monitor browse path → classify preference → match first-order offer → set popup timing. 3. Section A: Produces a Path→Segment table with columns 'Observed path pattern', 'Preference label', 'Rationale' mapping all 5 sessions to their correct segments: anon-7f3a=Category Intent, anon-2c91=Price Sensitive, anon-b804=Shipping Sensitive, anon-44ef=Single SKU Deep Dive, anon-9901=Bouncer. 4. Section B: Produces a Segment→First-order offer table using playbook-exact values: Category Intent=12% off/$85 min/excludes full-price tents >$400; Price Sensitive=$15 off/$60 min/no clearance stacking; Shipping Sensitive=Free ship/$50 min/no oversized; Single SKU Deep Dive=Gift with order/$120 min; Bouncer=8% off/$40 min. Mentions stack prohibition against WELCOME15/EARLYBIRD. 5. Section C: Trigger spec table with EXIT INTENT as the PRIMARY trigger (first row), Backup 1 = 25s on PDP, Backup 2 = second category/collection view — all from playbook, not generic. Columns: Trigger/When/Copy Role. 6. Includes modal headline + subline + CTA for at least the primary segments. 7. Does NOT confuse this with loyalty win-back flows. Output saved as new_shopper_activation_plan.md.
